items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: (To the question) The part that the lower one has already received from the upper one is discerned as an inner light. And what it is destined to receive from the upper one is discerned, even before it receives it, as illuminating to it in the aspect of a surrounding light, meaning an illumination from afar. (Item 77).
